payload.body: Withdraws the earlier Starlink "ask for link" card. It is replaced by listing starlink-referral, which links to Phoenix Collective's Starlink page.

listing.title: Starlink internet referral (ask for link)
listing.offerText: Ask Phoenix Collective for a Starlink referral link. No referral link is printed here.
listing.verifyLiveNote: Check plans, terms and availability for your address on starlink.com before you sign up.
listing.disclosure: Referral disclosure: Phoenix Collective may receive a referral credit from Starlink if you sign up with a link we send you. Starlink sets its own terms. Phoenix Collective is not affiliated with Starlink or SpaceX, and this node never handles payment.
